articles.title: Phillies building up Tanner Banks to multi-inning role as he nears return from injured list
articles.description: Banks, who has been out since July 9, has made four rehab appearances for Lehigh Valley as he builds into the three-inning range as a bulk option in the bullpen.

articles.title: Alex McFarlane gives up game-tying three-run homer as Braves top Phillies in NL East setback
articles.description: Despite Aaron Nola having a solid start and Kyle Schwarber and Derek Hill tacking on homers, the Phillies' eighth inning collapse sunk them back five games out of first place in the NL East.

articles.title: In the wake of Ronald Acuña’s blast, Phillies rookie Alex McFarlane remains the bullpen’s best hope
articles.description: Despite Sunday’s misfortune, the Phillies have little choice but to operate as if McFarlane will be the man who will fill the vacuum in the postseason.

articles.title: ‘He’s been so key for us’: Is Jhoan Duran having the best season ever by a Phillies closer?
articles.description: Duran recorded his 30th save this season on Saturday night to become the first Phillies reliever since Jeanmar Gómez in 2016 to hit the mark.

articles.title: MLB playoff tracker: Phillies wild-card and NL East standings; updated magic number
articles.description: The Phillies are looking for their third straight division title as they try to chase down the Braves, but their clearest path to the MLB postseason is currently via the wild-card spot.

articles.title: Familiar concerns arise for the Phillies in 5-2 series opening loss to the Braves
articles.description: The team's defense and bullpen remain question marks as the Phillies try to chase down Atlanta in the NL East race. The gap now sits at five games after the Phillies' loss.

articles.title: A fifth straight postseason is in sight. Here are the big things to watch from the Phillies over the final month.
articles.description: The playoff odds are in their favor so September should be more about gearing up for a postseason run than merely making it. And that includes waiting for Zack Wheeler and Trea Turner to get right.

articles.title: Phillies minor league director Luke Murton on Aidan Miller, the state of the farm system, and more
articles.description: With the minor league season winding down, Phillies farm director Luke Murton discusses the state of the system, upcoming changes to his role and offers an update on injured top prospect Aidan Miller.

articles.title: NBC Sports Philadelphia’s Tom McCarthy will miss most of Phillies-Angels series
articles.description: In addition to being the TV voice of the Phillies, McCarthy is entering his 13th season calling NFL games on CBS.
